name: WazirX Exchange / Liminal Custody Multisig
technique: UI transaction substitution; Social engineering; Payload integrity failure
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.78). Replaced keyword guess "social-engineering".
rootCause: On July 18, 2024, attackers substituted a malicious contract upgrade for a routine-looking transaction in WazirX's multisig wallet signing workflow. Signers approved what appeared to be normal, but the payload upgraded the wallet to attacker-controlled code. $235M in assets were drained, with only a small fraction later recovered. The root cause was the absence of cryptographic integrity checks between the displayed UI transaction details and the actual signed data, allowing substitution at the interface layer. The multisig transaction signing interface allowed UI-payload substitution: signers approved a transaction based on the displayed description,…
